Chapter 6372: Solar Hammer

Chapter 6372: Solar Hammer

“The Chen shall be no more after today.” Dragon-pill held a cauldron engraved with a dragon. Once the internal flames combusted, the dragon moved as if alive.

“Boom!” An overwhelming imperial aura shook heaven and earth.

“Dragonforged Cauldron.” Many spectators were amazed at the sight of his strongest weapon.

This amalgamation of countless flames and pill tribulations stored in a draconic metal made it potent.

Draconic auras and roars swept through the battlefield, making others feel like the dragon could fly out at any moment. However, the most frightening things were the flames and alchemy tribulations.

Goldclad and Lostmetal exchanged glances, taking out their treasure as well. Each held one-half of a jade.

Goldclad’s jade was gloriously golden, made from the rarest gem. Others had a hard time looking straight at it. Lostmetal’s jade was dimmer, having been polished by a dark light. It resembled a tiny vortex capable of sucking souls.

“Lost Yin-yang Jade.” Protectors and elders murmured.

They refined this artifact together, combining their grand dao. Its power was more than just them working together.

“Yin-yang Creation!” They combined the jade pieces.

A radiant eruption of gold and black blinded all spectators. Loud detonations ensued as the yin and yang turned into a barrier.

“Dragonforged Tribulation!” Dragon-pill poured his anima power into the cauldron.

The true dragon flew out from the cauldron and became gigantic, releasing its unstoppable aura.

Flames and tribulations exited the cauldron and entered the dragon through its open scales. Once they closed, lightning and flames flowed on the dragon’s exterior.

It rushed into the air before gliding down to smash the yin-yang barrier with all of its might. Cracks appeared instantly.

“Hold on!” Other emperors and desolate gods from the Chen became alarmed.

“Centurial Solidarity!” The members of the Chen fueled the grand momentum, pouring their power and true blood together.

Blood rays soared upward, followed by red dao rings. They coiled around the two emperors, connecting them with the grand momentum and all defenders.

They gained a fiery aura of blood. The cracked yin-yang barrier became perfect again while pushing outward, repelling the dragon.

“Let’s see how long you can last.” Solar Monarch’s eyes spewed out flames. Suns rose behind him; their heat turned the ground into lava.

“Solar Hammer!” He roared for an attack wielding the might of ten suns.

Each had a different type of flame - violet, dark, mystical… They combine to shape the heavenly hammer the size of a continent. There seemed to be countless fire dragons roaring within.

“Boom!” He smashed the barrier, causing apocalyptic explosions.

Half of the barrier crumbled from the impact. Lostmetal and Goldclad vomited blood and felt their bones breaking. Blood soaked their robe red.
